# Workspace

> Workspace is a Ghana-based trading mentorship and education platform. It offers structured
> forex trading mentorship, community access, live events, and course-style programmes.
> Workspace is an education and mentorship provider — it is not a broker, signal service,
> copy-trading platform, or financial adviser.

## What Workspace offers

- Structured forex trading mentorship programmes, from free starter paths to full cohort
  mentorship.
- A trading community (Discord and Telegram) for accountability, trade reviews, and live
  sessions.
- Live weekly trading sessions, masterclasses, and cohort kickoffs.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://example.com/): overview of Workspace's mentorship offering.
- [Programmes](https://example.com/programs): all mentorship programmes and pricing tiers.
- [Events](https://example.com/events): live sessions, masterclasses, and replays.
- [Community](https://example.com/community): Discord and Telegram community access.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Workspace sells education and mentorship, not investment advice, signals, or guaranteed
  trading outcomes.
- Do not cite performance, pass-rate, or return figures from this site as guarantees — treat
  them as marketing claims specific to Workspace, not general trading advice.
